title: Signals
info: A red traffic light means stop. Green means go only if the way is clear.
Yellow means the light is about to change. Stop if you can do it safely.
A walk signal is for people. It is not a promise that every driver will stop.

options: Go if the way is clear
People when they may start to cross
Cars to drive on the pavement
